unverified_claim.instructions: States a metric, result, or outcome that is NEITHER reported first-hand from the author's own work or measurement, NOR attributed to a named source. A first-person report of what the author personally measured or observed is sourced and is NOT a violation; an unattributed claim about the industry, a third party, or 'studies' is.

banned_words.instructions: Uses any of: unlock, empower, synergy, leverage, disrupt, hustle, utilize, iterate, optimize

hook_strength.instructions: How strongly does the opening line earn the next line
criteria: Stops the scroll and names a real tension

first_three_seconds.instructions: The first three seconds give a reason to keep watching or reading

saveable.instructions: This is worth saving or sending to someone, rather than merely scrolled past

medical_claim.instructions: Makes a health, medical, supplement, or body-composition claim that is stated as fact without a source

off_lane.instructions: This is B2B/AI-consulting content that belongs on LinkedIn rather than on a fitness and mindset account
